main_idea: Distillation gives a +20.9% and +21.4% net win-loss margin across two model families.
ideas: Distillation improves Nemotron student on GDPval
Same recipe transfers to Qwen family
Net win-loss margin vs base model is the result
Student learns from its own rollouts via teacher
